title: OP passive mobs
description: This pack makes the panda,  the bee and most importantly the snow golem OP.
body:
Overview This data pack completely revamps the mob loot system and item utility in Minecraft. It is designed for players who want a more rewarding and fast-paced survival experience by introducing unique mob drops and high-value item stacks.

Key Features

Bee Loot Overhaul: In this pack, bees are much more than just honey producers. Killing a bee now rewards you with **16 Panda Spawn Eggs**.

Ultimate Resource Loop: Those Panda Spawn Eggs can be used to obtain **4 stacks of Bottles o' Enchanting**, making experience gathering incredibly efficient.

The golem on steroids: The snow golem drops **an OP purple shulker box** with gear such as:

->Combat: Diamond gear, breeze rods and heavy cores, crossbow, trident, and enchanted books.
->Blocks: Enchanting tables, logs, obsidian, and iron/diamond/lapis blocks.
->Utility: Ender pearls, god and golden apples, and zombie villagers spawn eggs for better start (Snow Golem for more boxes, etc.).
->Optimized for Survival: No more grinding for hours. This pack streamlines the process of getting end-game materials and XP.

Why use this pack? If you are tired of the slow vanilla progression, this data pack adds a fun "OP" (Overpowered) twist to your world. Everything has been tested for compatibility and performance to ensure no lag during your gameplay. If you want to see fast progretion system just download my pack, it's free and it helps a lot.
